title: docs(skills): the dashboards rule stops teaching a per-series override on the compareTo comparison series
body:
Fixes #21211
Clause-②: no

Tier H (`skills/**`): a docs-only change to the published catalog. It stays a draft until an authorized APPROVED review; no seat readies, queues or arms it.

## What this does

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`, the `compareTo` section's **Cartesian charts** bullet (`:258`–`:262` on `c7396f1a`; the issue's `:257`–`:262` reading predates PR #21205), ended with:

> muted per family (dashed `'4 4'` on line/area only; reduced opacity on all). Override per-series with `series.dashArray` / `series.opacity`.

On a dataset-bound dashboard widget `chartConfig.series` is a `retiredKey` tombstone (`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts:961`), so the override sentence told an AI author to write a key the schema refuses by name. The sentence now reads:

> muted per family (dashed `'4 4'` on line/area only; reduced opacity on all). That muting is the renderer's default; `chartConfig.colors` is the one palette channel that remains.

Only that sentence changed: lines `:261`–`:262` replaced in place (+2 / -2, net 0 lines). The three sites PR #21205 edited (about `:185`, `:254`, `:341`) and every other bullet are untouched. After the edit the file has 0 hits for each of `dashArray`, `series.opacity` and `chartConfig.series`.

## Measured before editing

**The refusal (`reach:` reading).** `DashboardWidgetSchema.safeParse` from `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` at `c7396f1a`, run with `tsx` against the source, on a dataset-bound `line` widget (`dataset`, one `dimensions` entry, one `values` entry, `compareTo: { kind: 'previousPeriod' }`) whose `chartConfig` carries `colors` and `series: [{ name, dashArray: '2 2', opacity: 0.3 }]`:

- WITH `chartConfig.series` → **REFUSED**, one issue: `code: "invalid_type"`, `expected: "never"`, `path: ["chartConfig", "series"]`. The message is the tombstone's prescription; the operative sentences: "`dashboard.widgets[].chartConfig.series` was removed in @objectstack/spec 17.5.0 (ADR-0021 · ADR-0049 D2) … Delete the key. … Per-series appearance (label, colour, mark type, stacking) is not authorable on a dataset-bound widget; `colors` on this same chart config is the palette channel that remains."
- CONTROL, the same widget with `series` removed and `colors` kept → **ACCEPTED**.

An author following the old sentence got exactly that refusal. The new sentence names the channel the prescription names.

**The bullet is about dashboard widgets.** The section opens "Set `compareTo` on any data-bound widget to add a second query against a shifted time window", and `compareTo` is a `DashboardWidgetSchema` key (`dashboard.zod.ts:1116`). It is not a renderer-internal series option.

**The muting half of the sentence is true, read from the renderer.** objectui at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `31971ff1`, `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx:118`–`:132` (`seriesStyle`): `muted = s?.variant === 'comparison'`; `strokeDasharray` is `'4 4'` when muted on `line` and the area-like kinds, `undefined` otherwise; `strokeOpacity` / `fillOpacity` drop when muted on every cartesian kind (line 0.5 stroke; area 0.6 stroke / 0.2 fill; bar 0.4 fill; scatter 0.5 fill). The `dashArray` / `opacity` overrides that function also reads live on `ChartSeries` entries, which a dataset-bound widget cannot author (the refusal above); they stay authorable on the react `ObjectChart` tier, as the prescription says.

**`chartConfig.colors` reaches the dataset-bound widget.** Same objectui sha: `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx:1800` lowers `widget.chartConfig` through `chartConfigPresentation`, and `packages/core/src/utils/chart-presentation.ts:451` reads `colors` as the positional palette.

**The docs already say this.** `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx`, "What `chartConfig` does not carry": "`colors` on the chart config is the palette channel that remains." Not edited; the skill now agrees with it.

The +9 tokens are the true sentence that replaces the false one: the deleted sentence paid 66 bytes of the new sentence's 103. No ceiling moved, and no line was bought by re-wrapping.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` at `5dfa2034` derived 23 families, the same 23 the dispatch listed. All 23 were run with each exit code captured before any pipe; every one exited 0. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first answered exit 3 (prerequisite: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` not built in this worktree — "Nothing was measured"); after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock it answered exit 0 (58 self-test cases, 22 record-scoped examples across 458 files judged clean). `dispatch-gates --ran` over that record: 23 derived, 23 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (exit 0).

## Changeset

None: nothing under `skills/` is in any package's `files[]` (`skills` has 0 hits across every `packages/**/package.json`), so `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- Tier H: this PR waits for the maintainer's click; no seat readies, queues or arms it.
- Observed, not filed (dead code in the sibling repo): objectui `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx:1736` at `31971ff1` still calls `mergeAuthoredPresentation(series, widget?.chartConfig)` on the dataset path, a reader for the `series` key the spec refuses at parse, which a validated stack can never reach. Carrier: none.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:只改对外发布的 skill 文件 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` 里的一句话。`compareTo` 一节的「Cartesian charts」要点原来教 AI 用 `series.dashArray` / `series.opacity` 逐系列覆盖对比期系列的淡化样式;现在改为:淡化是渲染器的默认行为,`chartConfig.colors` 是绑定数据集的组件上仅剩的调色通道。净行数 0,token +9,仍在该文件原有上限之内,未动上限。

**为什么改**:在绑定数据集的仪表盘组件上,`chartConfig.series` 是 schema 按名拒收的墓碑键。AI 照着原句写元数据,校验直接报错——本 PR 用 spec 的 schema 实测:带 `series` 的组件被拒收,去掉后通过。发布的 skill 里一句错话就是产品缺陷,改法是让句子为真,不是加解释。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文档改动,不影响任何发布包,不改运行时行为。「淡化是渲染器默认」这半句已在 objectui 钉住版本的渲染器源码里核对,`chartConfig.colors` 确实到达绑定数据集的组件。回滚就是还原这一个文件。
